{{Quote|Get a medical capsule immediately!|[[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
A '''medical capsule''' was a type of specialized [[Hoversled/Legends|repulsorsled]] that was used for the transporting of injured individuals.

[[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] kept a [[PMC-210 medical capsule]] aboard his [[Theta-class T-2c shuttle/Legends|''Theta''-class shuttle]], and used it to transport the severely-wounded [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] from the lava fields of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], and later into the [[Emperor Palpatine Surgical Reconstruction Center]] for emergency surgery.
